answer: Bird ringing licence with ringing station records is the check: birds ringed at one station across many seasons. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The mirror signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 362 aliases needs 362 separate ringing records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The onyx ledger records each payment, the jetty window resets the board, and 362 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
